topic: Exploring the 2-adic Metric: Where Infinite Sums Behave Differently

sections.title: The Familiar World: Euclidean Distance
lecture_lines: Standard distance is the real line.
We measure distance by |x minus y|.
Series converge as points get closer.
animations: Draw Euclidean distance between two points using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] in #FFFFFF.
Highlight the squared differences (x2-x1)^2 and (y2-y1)^2 in #FFD700.
Combine these into the distance formula: sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) in #00FFFF.

sections.title: The 2-adic Perspective: Defining the Valuation
lecture_lines: We define 2-adic absolute value as 2 power -v2(x).
In this world, powers of 2 are tiny.
animations: Display the integer n = 2^k * m in #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg]
Isolate the power k as the 2-adic valuation v2(n) in #FFD700.
Animate k increasing as n becomes more divisible by 2 in #00FFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifying.svg]

sections.title: The Non-Archimedean Mystery
lecture_lines: Balls either do not intersect or nest.
animations: Show the ultrametric inequality d(x, z) <= max(d(x, y), d(y, z)) in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Visualize three points x, y, z forming an isosceles triangle in #FFD700 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Highlight that the longest side is equal to the other sides in #FF4500 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Infinite Sums: Convergence Reversal
lecture_lines: Terms must approach zero in the 2-adic sense.
animations: Show partial sums of 1 + 2 + 4 +... in #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/abacus.svg].
Transition from divergent in R to convergent in Q2 in #00FFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion: A New Mathematical Reality
lecture_lines: This is vital for modern number theory.
animations: Summarize R vs Q2 side-by-side in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Animate zooming out to show two distinct number lines in #FFD700.
